response.overview: Jumadi, a 69-year-old garbage cart collector, has spent more than 40 years working to support his family, despite his profession often being looked down upon by some members of society. His dedication has enabled his children to pursue higher education and earn university degrees. A few months before his youngest child’s wedding, his wife suffers a stroke and hopes to recover in time to attend the celebration. As she undergoes therapy and takes medication, Jumadi works harder to support his family while caring for his wife and managing the household.
